### Community Pulse Survey

In late June 2025, the first **Community Pulse Survey** was circulated with four short questions. A total of **49 responses** were received: English (41), French (5), and Spanish (3).

According to the survey, Collaboratory has a **Net Promoter Score of 48**: Promoters (56.5), Passives (34.8), Detractors (8.7). This is the extent to which Collaboratory members would recommend Collaboratory to a peer or colleague, indicating trust in the platform and desire to remain connected.

### **Member Satisfaction**

Current member satisfaction levels are as follows:

```{r}
#| fig-align: left
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 4
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| echo: false


ggplot(satisfaction_summary, aes(x = Satisfaction, y = pct)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.6, fill = "#00205C") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(pct, 1), "%")), 
            hjust = -0.1, size = 3.5) +  # labels just outside the bar
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  labs(
    title = "Member Satisfaction",
    x = "",
    y = ""
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, family = "Lato", color = "#2F3E46", face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, face = "italic", family = "Lato", color = "#2F3E46"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#f0f0f0"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

### Collaboratory Value

Members take value from the following areas offered by Collaboratory. The highest value offering of Collaboratory is **attending events (webinars, meetings, workshops, etc) at 89%**.

```{r}
#| fig-align: left
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 4
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| echo: false

# Plot diverging horizontal bars
ggplot(survey_summary, aes(x = Question, y = pct_signed, fill = Response)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.6) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_palette, name = "") +  # remove legend title
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(abs(x), "%"), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.1))) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = question_labels) +
  labs(
    title = "Have the following Collaboratory offerings added value to your work?",
    x = "",
    y = ""
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, family = "Lato", color = "#2F3E46", face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#f0f0f0"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )



```
